title: CYAN — Niche Genomic Analyses
text: Focused package niche genomic analyses sit outside scope main GAIA/HORIZON/CAULDRON pipeline. Currently implements RNA editing detection via REDItools2. Somatic variant calling via GATK MuTect2 planned yet implemented. package seen little use treated unreliable time . need arises, ’ll develop . Part L-Atelier repository. Like HORIZON, CYAN flat collection functions sub-modules; public functions prefixed CYAN_. Design principles: one sample per call (cohort looping left user), large intermediates written work_dir, final outputs output_dir. title: CYAN — Niche Genomic Analyses
text: CYAN_run_reditools() — detect RNA editing events (e.g. --) single BAM via REDItools2. Checkpoints raw output parsing (re-running skips REDItools2 checkpoint exists); defaults match REDItools2’s native defaults (min_coverage=1, min_edits=0, strict=FALSE, unfiltered output post-hoc filtering). Guards common REDItools2 pitfall: duplicate filter excludes reads already carry SAM duplicate flag (0x400) — BAM never markdup’d, filter silent -op, require_dup_marked=TRUE (default) hard-stops unless least one duplicate-flagged read found first. CYAN_run_reditools_batch() — convenience wrapper iterating CYAN_run_reditools() vector BAMs; per-sample error handling (failed sample warns continues rather aborting batch), inherits checkpoint behaviour.

title: CYAN — Niche Genomic Analyses
text: CYAN_run_reditools() writes output_dir: - {sample}_{date}_reditools.txt — full raw REDItools2 table (covered positions) - {sample}_{date}_reditools_subs.txt — substitution sites - {sample}_{date}_reditools.rds — parsed cyan_editing_result object (opt-save_rds = FALSE) parsed cyan_editing_result data.frame (one row per genomic position: region, position, reference, strand, coverage, mean_quality, per-base counts, all_subs, frequency), params attribute recording call’s arguments reproducibility.

title: Run REDItools2 RNA editing detection — CYAN_run_reditools
text: bam Character. Path sorted, indexed BAM file. reference Character. Path reference FASTA (must indexed samtools faidx). output_dir Character. Directory final result files (created absent). work_dir Character. Directory intermediate/temporary files (created absent). Defaults tempdir(). Can point external drive large datasets. sample_name Character NULL. Label used output filenames. Derived BAM filename NULL. strand_mode Integer. Library strandedness: 0 = unstranded (default), 1 = second-strand, 2 = first-strand. min_coverage Integer. Minimum read coverage position (default 1, matching REDItools2 native default). Increase (e.g. 10) suppress low-coverage noise post-hoc reduce output size. min_base_quality Integer. Minimum per-base quality score (default 30, matching REDItools2 native default). min_read_quality Integer. Minimum read mapping quality (default 20, matching REDItools2 native default). min_read_length Integer. Minimum read length; shorter reads discarded (default 30, matching REDItools2 native default). min_edits Integer. Minimum number edited reads position (default 0, matching REDItools2 native default). Filtering value post-hoc straightforward: result[result$frequency * result$coverage >= 3, ]. strict Logical. TRUE, positions detected substitutions written output. Default FALSE (matching REDItools2 native default) — covered positions reported. Set TRUE substantially reduce output size editing sites interest. region Character NULL. Restrict analysis genomic region samtools format (e.g. "chr21:1-10000000"). omopolymeric_file Character NULL. Path homopolymeric regions file. Recommended reduce false positives. splicing_file Character NULL. Path splice-site positions file. Recommended reduce mismatch artefacts near junctions. bed_file Character NULL. Path BED file target regions. Analysis restricted regions supplied. require_dup_marked Logical. TRUE (default), hard-stops running REDItools2 unless BAM least one read flagged duplicate (SAM FLAG 0x400). REDItools2's duplicate filter relies entirely flag already set upstream (e.g. via samtools markdup Picard MarkDuplicates) – BAM never duplicate-marked, filter silent -op. Set FALSE confident BAM genuinely duplicates flag. keep_tmp Logical. FALSE (default), intermediate files work_dir removed completion. save_rds Logical. TRUE (default), parsed result saved RDS file output_dir. verbose Logical. Print [CYAN] R-level progress messages (default TRUE). affect REDItools2's output. debug Logical. TRUE, passes -V REDItools2 routes stdout/stderr console (default FALSE). Use run fails need see raw Python output diagnose problem.

what: Check a BAM for duplicate-flagged reads (SAM FLAG 0x400) — .cyan_check_duplicates_marked
title: Check a BAM for duplicate-flagged reads (SAM FLAG 0x400) — .cyan_check_duplicates_marked
text: REDItools2's duplicate filter (read.is_duplicate, hardcoded reditools.py) excludes reads already carry flag – mark duplicates . BAM never run duplicate-marking tool (e.g. samtools markdup, Picard MarkDuplicates), flag never set filter silent -op, letting PCR-duplicate reads inflate editing-frequency estimates uncaught. scans least one flagged read cheap upstream sanity check, exiting immediately one found.
